processing: Selected adjusted float32 DEM instead of legacy half-metre JP2; EFFRES used only for quality assessment.
Transformed IAU centre to source CRS; extracted integer pixel window col=4229, row=1419, width=1250, height=1250.
No merging, reprojection, resampling, scaling or interpolation of output DEM. Valid source float32 elevations preserved exactly.
Source NoData is NaN. Invalid/masked samples mapped to finite float32 minimum sentinel for strict JSON-compatible metadata; valid zeros preserved.
Exported losslessly DEFLATE-compressed GeoTIFF with original lunar CRS/affine transform and explicit metre band units.

Preview uses existing backend render_rgba/encode_png on actual crop: 2nd-98th percentile display stretch, terrain colours, 315 degree azimuth/45 degree altitude hillshade; invalid samples transparent. 1250 x 1250 PNG; no map interpolation. Unlike Gale annotated matplotlib preview, plain raster uses the installed backend renderer without adding dependencies.
data_quality_notes: 100 km square projected crop centred on the IAU Mons Mouton position (-84.60, +31.00); covers a subset and surroundings, not the complete 130 km named feature.
Position authority: https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/16070 . Sphere makes planetographic and planetocentric latitude equal.
Product documentation: https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/90 ; Barker et al. 2023, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1; data doi:10.60903/gsfcpgda-lola-spole.
Source frame: MOON_ME of JPL DE421; projected lunar sphere radius 1737400 m. Elevations are metres above the lunar reference sphere, not a terrestrial or Mars datum.

Original source grid is 7600 x 7600, 80 m projected spacing, bounds [-304000.0, -304000.0, 304000.0, 304000.0] m. Nominal product is south of 80 S; square corners extend to lower latitudes. Crop is within source coverage.
Output geographic envelope [west,south,east,north] degrees, positive east (densified perimeter): [10.213763011201843, -86.80954438786723, 56.03519115151084, -82.32513765701721]
80 m is projected grid spacing, not effective terrain resolution. Crop EFFRES statistics: {"minimum_m": 7.188395023345947, "maximum_m": 300.5499267578125, "median_m": 23.834197998046875}
EFFRES is effective spatial resolution in metres, not elevation, vertical error or a void mask. It was inspected but not merged into the DEM.
Adjusted DEM is an existing gridded product; upstream interpolation may be present. No observation/count mask was provided. No additional gap filling or interpolation was performed here.

Legacy ldem_80s_80m.jp2 is an older elevation product, int16 with height scaling 0.5 m/DN per official PDS label; Rasterio alone reports scale 1 because the detached label is absent. Not used to fill or combine with adjusted elevations.

Schema compatibility limitation: coordinate_system.mars_radius_metres is null (not applicable to Moon); true lunar radius is in crs_wkt and these notes. All Mars metadata field names/nesting retained; no false Mars radius supplied.
Pipeline integration blocked: reference registry is Mars-only, loader enforces Mars radius, and ELEVATION_RANGE_M has no moon key. No pipeline changes made.
No detached label supplied for adjusted GeoTIFF; source_label points to the authoritative product documentation instead.
